name: /sdd:generate-tasks: refuses a verification that cannot fail
prompt:
/sdd:generate-tasks .specs/docs/specs/phase-1_widgets.md

Go ahead and write the task files.

graders.why: the spec proposes `echo ok`, which passes whether or not the work was done; copying it into the task file produces a gate that can never fire

graders.must_match: (?i)(pass(es|ed)?[^.\n]{0,40}(even if|even when|whether|regardless|without)|cannot fail|can never fail|always pass(es)?|did ?n.?t use the spec.{0,3}s suggested|would pass anyway)
graders.why: silently substituting a better command teaches nobody; it has to say the suggestion was rejected and why. Phrasing varies a lot, so this matches the idea rather than a form of words: an earlier attempt demanded 'cannot fail' and missed 'passes even if nothing was built'
the replacement has to be a command that exists in the repo, not a different placeholder
